# Astra Infotech

> Astra Infotech is a design & development studio that partners with founders and teams to turn ideas into fast, beautiful websites, apps, and brands. Based in India, working with clients worldwide.

Astra Infotech offers four core services: Web Development (React & Next.js, WordPress, Shopify, API & backend), App Development (native iOS & Android, Flutter, React Native), UI/UX Design (design systems, prototyping, user research), and Branding (identity, brand strategy, guidelines). The team works end-to-end — the same people who design a product also help build it — through a four-step process: Discover, Design, Develop, Deliver & Scale. Typical project timelines run 4–12 weeks. Clients range from early-stage startups building an MVP to established businesses modernizing an existing product or brand.
